title: Implementation Evaluation Schema
description: Schema for structured evaluation output of an implementation against a PRD and plan

errors.description: List of compilation error messages if status is 'failure'

compilation.description: Compilation results, contains whether compilation is succesfull and potential errors.

summary.description: Concise summary of the evaluation (1-3 sentences)

requirement_id.default: Identifier for the requirement this object is about.

notes.description: Any potential notes for the evaluation, e.g. why the requirement was not met.

compliance.description: List of PRD/requirements items and whether they are satisfied

id.description: A unique identifier for the finding, e.g., 'FIND-001'

title.description: A brief, descriptive title of the finding.

description.description: A detailed description of the finding.

impact.description: What impact this finding can have on the project, the likelihood of this finding actually occurring and how damaging it could be if it did occur.

evidence.description: The evidence for the finding as a source code passage, formatted as: <file>:<line-range> — <brief snippet or description>.

findings.description: Concrete issues, gaps, or observations discovered during evaluation

id.description: Identifier for the test suite or execution, e.g., 'TEST-001'

passing.description: List of test case identifiers that passed.

failing.description: List of test case identifiers that failed.

coverage_pct.description: The coverage percentage of the unit tests on the project.

notes.description: Any potential notes for the evaluation, e.g. why some tests might be failing or not cover certain parts of the codebase.

unit.description: Unit tests information, passing tests, failing tests, coverage, etc.

passing.description: List of test case identifiers that passed.

failing.description: List of test case identifiers that failed.

notes.description: Any potential notes for the evaluation, e.g. why some tests might be failing or not cover certain parts of the codebase.

integration.description: Integration tests information, passing tests, failing tests, etc.

notes.description: Any potential notes for the evaluation, e.g. why some tests might be failing or not cover certain parts of the codebase.

e2e.description: Detailed results of test executions across different levels (unit, integration, end-to-end)

test_results.description: Summary of test executions and coverage

id.description: A unique identifier for the recommendation, e.g., 'REC-001'

action.description: A detailed description of the recommended action to address the finding.

verification.description: A description of how the recommendation will be verified.

linked_finding_ids.description: IDs of findings this recommendation addresses

recommendations.description: Prioritized, actionable recommendations to remediate findings

documentation.description: The level of documentation provided for the implementation, e.g., 'comprehensive', 'adequate', 'insufficient'. Also include actionable improvements.

functional_suitability.description: Evaluation of how well the implementation meets the specified functional requirements. Include actionable improvements.

performance_efficiency.description: Evaluation of the implementation's performance under specified conditions. Include actionable improvements.

compatibility.description: Evaluation of the implementation's compatibility with other systems or environments. Include actionable improvements.

usability.description: Evaluation of the implementation's ease of use and user experience. Include actionable improvements.

reliability.description: Evaluation of the implementation's ability to perform consistently under specified conditions. Include actionable improvements.

security.description: Evaluation of the implementation's ability to protect against unauthorized access and vulnerabilities. Include actionable improvements.

portability.description: Evaluation of the implementation's ability to be transferred from one environment to another. Include actionable improvements.

iso_25010.description: Evaluation of the implementation against ISO 25010 quality standards. Excludes maintainability, which is evaluated separately.

general.description: General evaluation of the maintainability of the codebase. Include actionable improvements.

code_readability.description: Evaluation of how easily the code can be read and understood. Include actionable improvements.

modularity.description: Evaluation of how well the code is organized into modules or components. Include actionable improvements.

documentation_quality.description: Evaluation of the quality and completeness of the code documentation. Include actionable improvements.

test_coverage.description: Evaluation of the extent to which the code is covered by tests. Include actionable improvements.

maintainability.description: Maintainability evaluation. Follow ISO 25010 maintainability criteria.

next.description: Indicates the next phase to execute. Can ONLY be 'finish' or 'revise'. If 'finish', the pipeline will proceed to finish. If 'revise', the pipeline will loop back to the revise phase for further improvements.
